notes.title: Update 1.9.11 Fixes and Improvements and Settings Reset!
notes.content:
[h1]Cyber Sentinel – Changelog [/h1]

[b]v1.9.10 – Web Steam Fallback[/b]
Full API compatibility and offline achievement tracking via localStorage

Added onAchievementUnlocked() event system

Improved type safety and developer tools

Production-ready browser fallback for Steam

[b]v1.9.9 – Greenworks Integration[/b]
Replaced steamworks.js with Greenworks

Full Steam API support (achievements, overlay, Steam ID)

Multi-platform support (Electron, Tauri, Web)

Includes TypeScript types and debug tools

[b]v1.9.6 – XP Gem Sound[/b]
New sound for XP gem collection (collectdata.mp3)

Triggers for both player and drone pickups

Applies to all gem types with 70% base volume

[b]v1.9.5 – Weapon Sounds[/b]
Added sounds for machine gun, shotgun, reload, and ammo pickup

Balanced volume (80–90% of base)

Enhances combat feedback

[b]v1.9.4 – Ability Shortcuts[/b]
New keybinds: Z (Freeze), C (Burn), Shift+C (Flood), Shift+V (Virus)

Conflict-free and theme-consistent

[b]v1.9.3 – Upgrade Menu Shortcut[/b]
V key now closes the Upgrade Menu (also ESC, S)

Improves accessibility and control

[b]v1.9.2 – Achievements Finalized[/b]
Full implementation of 40 achievements

Includes test panel and debug tools

Ready for production deployment

[b]v1.9.1 – Overload Fix[/b]
Effect now targets only visible enemies inside the red circle

Added bounds and visibility checks for fairness

[b]v1.9.0 – Achievement System Init[/b]
Introduced Steam achievement tracking (40 total)

Auto fallback for offline mode

Includes debug shortcuts for testing

[b]v1.8.2 – Settings UI Fix[/b]
Clear labels: "ENABLED"/"DISABLED" with color indicators

Resolved previous confusion with toggle states

[b]v1.8.1 – Reroll Reset + Cost Display[/b]
Reroll penalty resets after 2 level-ups

Fixed upgrade menu to show accurate costs

[b]v1.8.0 – Balance Update[/b]
Player base damage increased by 4.7%

SummonerEnemy nerfed: reduced minions, slower spawn, longer cooldown

Improved early and mid-game balance

Language Support
Language	Status
English (🇺🇸)	Complete (Native)
Chinese – Simplified (🇨🇳)	Complete
French (🇫🇷)	Complete
German (🇩🇪)	Complete
Japanese (🇯🇵)	Complete

notes.title: Small Patch: Better Localization + Balance Adjustments
notes.content:
[p]Thank you all for the support so far![/p][p]I’ve been testing the game a lot lately and even streaming some of it. Based on feedback and ongoing testing, I’ve started making more balance adjustments.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Early game player damage has been increased slightly to improve pacing and challenge.[/p][p]Small fixes have been made to some enemies and abilities.[/p][p]The reroll penalty has been nerfed it now clears after two level-ups.[/p][p]A shield has been added to the boss encounter, along with a slight bluff to make the boss feel a bit tankier overall.[/p][p][/p][p]Game localization has been improved across the board and will continue to be updated.[/p][p]If you run into any issues or have suggestions, please let me know your feedback really helps me make the game better.[/p][p]Thanks again for all the support! I’m truly happy to see so many of you enjoying the game. What matters most to me is improving it further and making sure it stays fun for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Hint:[/b][/p][p]You can change the game language in the settings![/p][p]P.S.: Japanese will be added in the next update hopefully by Monday if all goes well!
